metrics.definition_en: IP service availability is calculated from the cited standard's measurement parameters.
metrics.definition_zh: IP业务可用率依据所引标准的测量参数计算。
metrics.derivation_rule: Operational derivation: divide classified available seconds by observed scheduled seconds over PT15M. ITU-T Y.1540 defines availability using Tav intervals and an IPLR-based state function; it does not prescribe this seconds-based aggregation.

evidence.quote: An availability function (defined in clause 7.1) serves to classify the total scheduled service time for an IP service into available and unavailable periods.

metrics.definition_en: Ethernet frame loss ratio is calculated from the cited standard's measurement parameters.

metrics.definition_en: Ethernet one-way frame delay is calculated from the cited standard's measurement parameters.
metrics.definition_zh: 以太网单向帧时延依据所引标准的测量参数计算。
metrics.derivation_rule: Operational derivation: calculate each synchronized one-way frame delay and take the arithmetic mean over PT15M. ITU-T G.8013 defines the delay primitive but does not prescribe this windowed mean formula.

evidence.quote: one-way frame delay is defined as the time elapsed from the start of transmission of the first bit of the frame

metrics.definition_en: Ethernet frame delay variation is calculated from the cited standard's measurement parameters.
metrics.definition_zh: 以太网帧时延变化依据所引标准的测量参数计算。
metrics.derivation_rule: Operational derivation: take the 99th percentile of collected Ethernet frame-delay-variation samples over PT15M. ITU-T G.8013 defines the variation primitive but not this percentile or window.

evidence.quote: Frame delay variation is a measure of the variations in the frame delay between a pair of service frames.

metrics.definition_en: Ethernet test throughput is calculated from the cited standard's measurement parameters.
metrics.definition_zh: 以太网测试吞吐率依据所引标准的测量参数计算。

evidence.quote: Throughput is the average rate of successful traffic delivery over a communication channel.

metrics.definition_en: Ethernet severely errored second ratio is calculated from the cited standard's measurement parameters.
metrics.definition_zh: 以太网严重误码秒比依据所引标准的测量参数计算。
metrics.derivation_rule: Operational derivation: divide Ethernet severely errored seconds by observed seconds over PT15M. ITU-T G.8013 identifies SES contributions to unavailable time but does not define this ratio or window.

evidence.quote: Both near-end and far-end frame loss measurements contribute to near-end severely errored seconds

metrics.definition_en: OTN BIP-8 errored block ratio is calculated from the cited standard's measurement parameters.
metrics.definition_zh: OTN BIP-8误块率依据所引标准的测量参数计算。
metrics.derivation_rule: Operational derivation: divide equipment-reported ODU BIP-8 errored blocks by monitored blocks over PT15M. ITU-T G.709 defines the error-detection code but not this ratio or window.

evidence.quote: For path monitoring, a one-byte error detection code signal is defined in the ODU PM overhead.

metrics.definition_en: OTN backward error indication rate is calculated from the cited standard's measurement parameters.
metrics.definition_zh: OTN后向误码指示率依据所引标准的测量参数计算。
metrics.derivation_rule: Operational derivation: divide decoded ODU PM BEI counts by observed seconds over PT15M. ITU-T G.709 defines the BEI count field but not an indications-per-second KPI.

evidence.quote: a four-bit backward error indication (BEI) signal is defined to convey in the upstream direction the count of interleaved-bit blocks

metrics.definition_en: OTN FEC corrected bit rate is calculated from the cited standard's measurement parameters.
metrics.definition_zh: OTN FEC纠正比特率依据所引标准的测量参数计算。
metrics.derivation_rule: Operational derivation: divide equipment-reported corrected-bit counts by observed seconds over PT15M. ITU-T G.709 specifies FEC correction capability but does not define this bit-rate KPI.

evidence.quote: The code can correct up to 8 symbol errors in the FEC code word when it is used for error correction.

metrics.definition_en: OTN FEC uncorrectable block rate is calculated from the cited standard's measurement parameters.
metrics.definition_zh: OTN FEC不可纠错块率依据所引标准的测量参数计算。
metrics.derivation_rule: Operational derivation: divide equipment-reported uncorrectable FEC-block counts by observed seconds over PT15M. ITU-T G.709 defines FEC detection capability but not this block-rate KPI.

evidence.quote: The FEC can detect up to 16 symbol errors in the FEC code word

metrics.definition_en: MPLS packet loss ratio is calculated from the cited standard's measurement parameters.
metrics.definition_zh: MPLS分组丢失率依据所引标准的测量参数计算。
metrics.derivation_rule: Operational derivation: compute lost packets as transmitted minus received, then divide by transmitted packets over PT15M. RFC 6374 defines interval loss counts but not this loss-ratio formula or window.

evidence.quote: they represent the total transmit and receive loss over the channel since the LM operation was initiated.

metrics.definition_en: MPLS one-way packet delay is calculated from the cited standard's measurement parameters.
metrics.definition_zh: MPLS单向分组时延依据所引标准的测量参数计算。

evidence.quote: forward one-way delay = T2 - T1

metrics.definition_en: MPLS packet delay variation is calculated from the cited standard's measurement parameters.
metrics.definition_zh: MPLS分组时延变化依据所引标准的测量参数计算。
metrics.derivation_rule: Operational derivation: take the 99th percentile of MPLS PDV samples over PT15M. RFC 6374 defines PDV from one-way delay but does not prescribe this percentile or window.

evidence.quote: PDV, given a measurement test interval, represents the difference between the one-way delay of a packet in the interval
